name: Power Menu
author: robbie
description: Power button in the bar with a dropdown for lock, suspend, logout, reboot and shutdown

barWidget.description: Power button in the top-right of the bar. Opens a dropdown with session actions: Lock, Suspend, Hibernate (when available), Logout, Reboot, Shutdown, Update System, Screen Saver and the option to add the widget to the Omarchy menu. Destructive actions ask for a second click to confirm.
